name: aquilair-fde
description: LLM 辅助本体元数据设计 v0.4.0：设计稿确认关卡/拓扑图片+studio-model yaml 双交付/OQ 生命周期/资产回流进化
license: Proprietary - Aquilair internal distribution, intranet use only

displayDescription.en: Designs ontology metadata from business documents: intake and filing, scenario charter, DSL drafting, hard lint, CQ verification, topology and change-set diff, engine-bundle export. Drafts only - human review is the sole authority.
displayDescription.zh: 从业务资料设计本体元数据：资料摄取归位、场景圈定、DSL 起草、硬校验、CQ 回验、拓扑与变更集 diff、引擎注册格式导出。只产草稿，人工审核是唯一权威。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我有一批业务资料（DDL/数据字典/需求与规则文档/访谈记录），帮我从资料包摄取开始，设计一份可审核的本体草稿
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have a set of business documents (DDL / data dictionary / requirement & rule docs / interviews). Start from brief intake and design a reviewable ontology draft for me.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我从业务资料开始设计一个可审核的本体草稿
quickPrompts.en: Help me design a reviewable ontology draft from business documents.

quickPrompts.zh: 比较当前本体与这份业务方案的差异，只生成变更建议
quickPrompts.en: Compare the current ontology with this business proposal and generate change suggestions only.

quickPrompts.zh: 校验/评审当前本体是否支撑目标业务场景
quickPrompts.en: Validate and review whether the current ontology supports the target business scenarios.
